```{r}
movies <- readRDS(here("data", "movies_clean.rds"))

create_time_series_analysis <- function(data) {
  # 确保有 Year 列
  if (!"Year" %in% colnames(data)) {
    if ("Released_year" %in% colnames(data)) {
      data <- data %>% dplyr::mutate(Year = Released_year)
    } else if ("Released" %in% colnames(data)) {
      data <- data %>% dplyr::mutate(Year = lubridate::year(Released))
    } else {
      stop("No Year or Released_year column found in dataset.")
    }
  }

  # 按年汇总
  yearly_stats <- data %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Year) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      total_revenue = sum(BoxOffice_adjusted, na.rm = TRUE) / 1e9,
      movie_count   = dplyr::n(),
      avg_rating    = mean(imdbRating, na.rm = TRUE),
      avg_runtime   = mean(Runtime_num, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups       = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(Year >= 2000)

  # 各指标的 y 轴范围（多留一点空）
  rev_range   <- range(yearly_stats$total_revenue, na.rm = TRUE)
  rev_range   <- rev_range + c(-0.1, 0.1) * diff(rev_range)

  cnt_range   <- range(yearly_stats$movie_count / 100, na.rm = TRUE)
  cnt_range   <- cnt_range + c(-0.1, 0.1) * diff(cnt_range)

  rate_range  <- range(yearly_stats$avg_rating, na.rm = TRUE)
  rate_range  <- rate_range + c(-0.1, 0.1) * diff(rate_range)

  runtime_range <- range(yearly_stats$avg_runtime, na.rm = TRUE)
  runtime_range <- runtime_range + c(-0.1, 0.1) * diff(runtime_range)

  # 基础图：4 条线都挂在同一个 y 轴上，但默认只显示 revenue
  ts_plot <- plotly::plot_ly(yearly_stats) %>%
    # 1. Total Revenue
    plotly::add_trace(
      x = ~Year,
      y = ~total_revenue,
      type = "scatter",
      mode = "lines+markers",
      name = "Total Revenue (2024 adj.)",
      line   = list(color = "darkblue", width = 3),
      marker = list(size = 7),
      visible = TRUE,
      text = ~paste0(
        "Year: ", Year,
        "<br>Total Revenue: ", round(total_revenue, 2), " B$",
        "<br>Movie Count: ", movie_count,
        "<br>Avg Rating: ", round(avg_rating, 2),
        "<br>Avg Runtime: ", round(avg_runtime, 1), " min"
      ),
      hovertemplate = "%{text}<extra></extra>"
    ) %>%

    # 2. Movie Count (÷100)
    plotly::add_trace(
      x = ~Year,
      y = ~movie_count / 100,
      type = "scatter",
      mode = "lines+markers",
      name = "Movie Count (÷100)",
      line   = list(color = "darkgreen", width = 2),
      marker = list(size = 6),
      visible = FALSE
    ) %>%

    # 3. Average Rating
    plotly::add_trace(
      x = ~Year,
      y = ~avg_rating,
      type = "scatter",
      mode = "lines+markers",
      name = "Avg Rating",
      line   = list(color = "firebrick", width = 2),
      marker = list(size = 6),
      visible = FALSE
    ) %>%

    # 4. Average Runtime
    plotly::add_trace(
      x = ~Year,
      y = ~avg_runtime,
      type = "scatter",
      mode = "lines+markers",
      name = "Avg Runtime (min)",
      line   = list(color = "orange", width = 2),
      marker = list(size = 6),
      visible = FALSE
    ) %>%

    # 布局 + 下拉菜单
    plotly::layout(
      title = "Movie Industry Trends Over Time (Inflation-Adjusted)",
      xaxis = list(title = "Year"),
      yaxis = list(
        title = "Total Revenue (Billion USD, 2024 adj.)",
        range = rev_range
      ),
      hovermode = "x unified",
      legend    = list(orientation = "h", x = 0.2, y = -0.1),
      margin    = list(l = 80, r = 60, t = 60, b = 60),
      updatemenus = list(
        list(
          type = "dropdown",
          direction = "down",
          x = 1.05,
          xanchor = "left",
          y = 0.9,
          buttons = list(
            # Revenue
            list(
              label  = "Revenue only",
              method = "update",
              args = list(
                list(visible = c(TRUE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE)),
                list(yaxis = list(
                  title = "Total Revenue (Billion USD, 2024 adj.)",
                  range = rev_range
                ))
              )
            ),
            # Movie Count
            list(
              label  = "Movie Count only",
              method = "update",
              args = list(
                list(visible = c(FALSE, TRUE, FALSE, FALSE)),
                list(yaxis = list(
                  title = "Movie Count (÷100)",
                  range = cnt_range
                ))
              )
            ),
            # Rating
            list(
              label  = "Rating only",
              method = "update",
              args = list(
                list(visible = c(FALSE, FALSE, TRUE, FALSE)),
                list(yaxis = list(
                  title = "Average Rating",
                  range = rate_range
                ))
              )
            ),
            # Runtime
            list(
              label  = "Runtime only",
              method = "update",
              args = list(
                list(visible = c(FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, TRUE)),
                list(yaxis = list(
                  title = "Average Runtime (minutes)",
                  range = runtime_range
                ))
              )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )

  ts_plot
}


```

```{r}
ts_plot <- create_time_series_analysis(movies)
ts_plot

htmlwidgets::saveWidget(ts_plot, "time_series_4metrics.html", selfcontained = TRUE)

```
